blocks.text:
Take in the breathtaking view as your plane descends upon Rio de Janeiro, the “Marvellous City”, where green hills, turquoise ocean, sandy beaches and high-rise neighbourhoods come together in a unique blend of life. Your driver takes you from the airport to the hotel, past colonial-style buildings and along the world-famous beachfront.

The natural beauty of Rio, framed by the Atlantic rainforest, sits alongside everything that makes a great Latin American city. A walk along the mosaic promenade of Copacabana reveals much about the life of the cariocas, as Rio’s locals are known: a refreshing caipirinha as the waves lap the shore, a fiercely competitive game of foot-volley and crowds enjoying the sun on the golden sand.

Recommended optional evening activity: the Rio by Night show with dinner (see Optional excursions).

Included: Airport – hotel transfer with driver
